# Locations & Battles

## Academy {#academy}

The Academy, also known as Queen's, is an educational institution located in town near [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) where students from various places, including [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), pursue First Class or Second Class teacher's licenses and compete for honors such as medals and the Avery scholarship.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue, named by the locals of [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) and dubbed the "White Way of Delight" by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), is a four- to five-hundred-yard stretch of road completely arched over by wide-spreading apple trees planted by an eccentric old farmer.

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is a rural community where [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), home to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Lovers' Lane are located.

**Associated with:** [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of the Barrys' kitchen roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for her and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) summons the doctor. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visits from her schoolmates, friends, and neighbors.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

## Beechwood {#beechwood}

Beechwood is the residence of [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), located in town, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays while taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams.

**Associated with:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a narrow, scenic woodland trail fringed with white birches and wild flora that runs through Mr. Bell's woods to the main road, serving as part of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's picturesque route to school.

> As life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) settles back into a routine after the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and walks along Birch Path with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), discussing her birthday, a fictional story she wrote, and the idea of forming a story club. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains the newly formed story club to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who scoffs at the endeavor as a foolish waste of time while reminding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to focus on her chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a town in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born in a small yellow house, and where her parents, Walter and Bertha Shirley, worked as high school teachers before both dying of fever.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md)

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location eight miles from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a train station house with a long platform and a small hotel with a yard.

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy sent by Mrs. [Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), but finds an eleven-year-old girl waiting instead. Unwilling to break the news of the mistake immediately, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) takes the talkative child into his buggy and begins driving her toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as she converses lively about her imagination and life.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

## Camelot {#camelot}

Camelot is a romantic, historical setting featured in Tennyson's poetry, which [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) envies for its old-fashioned romance and incorporates into a dramatic game with her friends.

## Canadian {#canadian}

Canadian refers to a native-born individual from Canada, whom [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) preferred to adopt over a child from England or the United [States](../codex/places.md#states).

## Carmody {#carmody}

Carmody is a nearby location that hosts meetings for the Aid Society.

## Charlottetown {#charlottetown}

Charlottetown is a location on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) where travelers can board a train and observe the area's distinctive red roads.

## Dryad’s Bubble {#dryad-s-bubble}

The Dryad's Bubble is a spring located in a hollow near a log bridge and a spruce path that leads to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) after a spring in a story.

## Edward Island {#edward-island}

Edward Island, also referred to as Prince Edward Island, is a region where custom dictates that travelers nod to everyone they meet on the road.

## Entrance {#entrance}

The Entrance is an examination taken by advanced students to qualify for admission into Queen's.

**Participants:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)

## Exhibition {#exhibition}

The Exhibition is an event held in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to which [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) invited [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit and stay with her at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood).

**Participants:** [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md)

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family homestead in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a big, rambling house situated at the far edge of their cleared land at the end of a long, grassy lane.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at Green Gables and admires the beautiful morning scenery from her bedroom window before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comes in to tell her to get dressed. During a quiet breakfast, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chatter-talks until silenced, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) frustrated by both Anne's imaginative rambling and Matthew's silent desire to keep the girl. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps with chores, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive her to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to settle her return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrive at Mrs. Spencer's house to clarify the mix-up regarding the orphan child. When Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates after seeing Mrs. Blewett's harsh demeanor and Anne's distress, deciding instead to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Upon returning to Green Gables, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and adopt her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying her prayers. After learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed before, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs her to compose her own prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers in an unusual, formal manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to the kitchen and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious instruction, vowing to begin educating her immediately.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to keep her at Green Gables, bringing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to overwhelmed, joyful tears. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, but catches her daydreaming in front of a painting in the sitting room. After discussing past imaginary friends and potential neighbors like [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is sent to her bedroom to finish memorizing the prayer, where she imagines lavish decor before settling happily into her new life as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of Green Gables.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits Green Gables and severely insults Anne's looks, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a furious rage and yell at her. After Mrs. Rachel leaves in an huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her bedroom and demands she apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adamantly refuses.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

## Haunted Wood {#haunted-wood}

The Haunted Wood is a gloomy spruce grove located over the brook that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imaginatively populated with romantic ghosts, including a wailing white lady, a murdered child's ghost near [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), a headless man, and skeletons.

## Hopeton {#hopeton}

Hopeton is a place where Mrs. Alexander Spencer's cousin lives and the location of an orphan asylum.

## Idlewild {#idlewild}

Idlewild is the poetical name invented by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the playhouse she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set up in a ring of white birch trees on Mr. William Bell's land.

## Lover’s Lane {#lover-s-lane}

Lover's Lane is a romantic, maple-canopied lane that extends from below the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard to the end of the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm, serving as part of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's scenic walk to school as well as a path for hauling wood and moving cows.

## Lynde’s Hollow {#lynde-s-hollow}

Lynde’s Hollow is a depression where the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) main road dips down, featuring a home, an orchard, a quiet brook fringed with alders and ladies’ eardrops, and a view of the steep red hill road leading out of the peninsula.

## Marysville {#marysville}

Marysville is a place where Mr. and Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas.md) moved after leaving [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) lived and briefly attended school until she was eight years old.

## Merry Christmas {#merry-christmas}

On a snowy morning in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a fashionable brown dress with puffed sleeves from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), a matching hair ribbon from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and dainty kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) before starring in a successful evening concert at the local hall.

## New Brunswick {#new-brunswick}

New Brunswick is a region where [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visited his cousins over the summer and the location of a tragic incident in which an adopted girl poisoned her family's well.

## Newbridge {#newbridge}

Newbridge is a bustling little village featuring a tree-canopied stretch of road called the "[Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue)" that leads down a long slope into the town.

## Nova Scotia {#nova-scotia}

Nova Scotia is a [Canadian](../codex/places.md#canadian) region home to an orphan asylum, situated close to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island).

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md)

## Orchard Slope {#orchard-slope}

Orchard Slope is the home of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her family, featuring a house with a western gable located up through a brook and the firs from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

**Associated with:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)

> After discussing the bed-jumping incident with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Orchard Slope to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Anne's dramatic honesty and charm win over Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue paying for Diana's music lessons.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

## Shining Waters {#shining-waters}

The Lake of Shining Waters is a long, winding body of water—locally known as Barry's pond—spanned by a bridge and surrounded by sand-hills, marshland, and groves of fir and maple.

## Snow Queen {#snow-queen}

The Snow Queen is the name given by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the exceptionally white, blooming cherry tree located outside her bedroom window.

## Spencervale {#spencervale}

Spencervale is a nearby locale whose resident physician attended to [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during her bout with croup and later advised [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's health.

**Associated with:** [Chester Ross](../character/chester-ross.md)

## States {#states}

The States is a foreign region where French farm workers frequently relocate after learning local agricultural practices, located at a greater distance from Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) than [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Violet Vale is a green dimple in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's woods, named by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), that sits along the scenic route she and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) take to school and is said to be filled with millions of violets in the spring.

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

The White Sands Hotel is a large establishment run by Mr. Kirke along the shore, popular with American tourists visiting for the summer season.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before driving to the White Sands Hotel with [Billy](../character/billy.md) and Jane for a charity concert. At the event, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers from severe stage fright upon facing the elegant audience and seeing professional performers. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, she finds her resolve, performs wonderfully, receives an encore, and enjoys a triumphant evening.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

## Willowmere {#willowmere}

Willowmere is a scenic location situated past Mr. Barry's back field along the romantic route that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school.
